attacks.attack: Triangle products do not detect curvature on a chordless cycle, so a triangle-only flatness argument would be incomplete.
attacks.response: The proof uses a rooted spanning tree and every non-tree fundamental cycle. It permits triangle reduction only after a triangle-span or triangulation hypothesis is declared.

attacks.attack: The connection-Laplacian kernel theorem could have been used illegitimately as a probability-law agreement theorem.
attacks.response: Frame fixed spaces and state-law stabilization are proved separately. CE-3 and CE-4 refute both attempted identifications, while zero distortion follows directly from KL positivity.

attacks.attack: A zero reverse attention weight could prevent the orientation needed for path propagation.
attacks.response: Every undirected support edge has at least one positive orientation and a reciprocal bimeasurable transport. Pushing an equality through the inverse supplies the reverse-oriented equality.

attacks.attack: Splitting Radon-Nikodym logarithms may hide an undefined infinity-minus-infinity operation.
attacks.response: The derivation separates support failure, infinite mixture-to-comparison KL, and the finite integrable case. Algebra is used only in the finite case; the other cases close by support and convexity.

attacks.attack: A formal group average may not exist or may fail the KL interchange for continuous or noncompact holonomy.
attacks.response: Finite holonomy uses normalized counting measure. Compact continuous holonomy is explicitly conditional on measurable domination and finite-integral hypotheses. The general noncompact extension is left open.

attacks.attack: The approximate agreement argument may have summed KL values along incompatible shortest paths.
attacks.response: One rooted spanning tree is fixed for every transport. Pinsker is applied on selected tree-edge orientations and only total variation is telescoped along the unique tree paths, with the tree diameter as the constant.

attacks.attack: Using a product of two membership kernels could erase correlations in the endpoint assignment.
attacks.response: The product is labeled as the conditional-independence specialization. The general theorem accepts an explicitly normalized correlated endpoint kernel and pushes the full joint event law.

attacks.attack: Replacing conditional transport marks by an arithmetic mean can leave the group and lose mark-feature correlation.
attacks.response: The exact state retains the conditional mark law or raw marked edges. Opposite quarter-turns average to the singular zero matrix, so no averaged-link claim is made.

attacks.attack: A coarse channel chosen after seeing the recognition law could manufacture zero VFE defect.
attacks.response: Recognition independence and one common channel for both laws are frozen premises. The theorem retains the conditional-KL defect and asserts equality only at almost-sure conditional-law equality.

attacks.attack: Calling a replicated cover soft can duplicate one child's mass and shared factors across several full parents.
attacks.response: Soft membership is normalized; literal replication is a separate nonnormalized type. CE-8 records parent mass two and replicated self-edge mass four.

attacks.attack: The frozen semiconjugacy equation omits motion of a time-dependent partition or coarse map.
attacks.response: The certified identity contains partial_t C_t. The frozen equation is only a specialization, and dynamically selected memberships remain open.

attacks.attack: The affirmative conjunction may rest only on selected finite Python checks and decimal logarithms.
attacks.response: Every mathematical dependency has direct DERIVATION evidence. The script and output close only a separate NUMERICAL_OBSERVATION and explicitly declare theorem_proof false.

independent_reconstruction.method: Sequentially reconstruct every dependency from the frozen contract and atomic claim statements without using the root guide or the direct derivation's prose order as a premise.
independent_reconstruction.conclusion: Every target dependency reconstructs under the recorded side conditions; role separation is not independent-agent agreement.

oracle_erasure.method: Remove the affirmative search preference from the logical context, rescan every premise for direct or paraphrased target assumptions, and recompute the dependency closure from typed premises alone.
oracle_erasure.conclusion: No target conjunct or dependency requires the erased preference; the mathematical derivations remain the closure evidence.
